name: rust-monorepo-ts-crates
title: Rust + TypeScript Monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo: Rust crates + TypeScript packages under Turborepo, with buf/protobuf codegen, Biome, clippy::pedantic, and Changesets.

registry.note: Nearly verbatim from a real package-manager monorepo (Rust + TS + proto). Rare in that it covers both toolchains coherently — most configs pick one side and hand-wave the other.
